sentences.en: My thirteen year old girl loves to watch romance movies.
sentences.zh: 我十三岁的女儿喜欢看爱情电影。

sentences.en: Deceiving others. That is what the world calls a romance.
sentences.zh: 欺骗别人。这就是世人所谓的浪漫。

sentences.en: To love oneself is the beginning of a life-long romance.
sentences.zh: 爱自己是 lifelong romance 的开始。
